newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Fazio says job creation is a major concern.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Fazio says job creation is a major concern.

text.p: Governor of the Bank of Italy Antonio Fazio said on Thursday that the importance of creating jobs was recognised by everybody.
Fazio was speaking at a convention organised by the Italian bishops' conference the day after the first meeting between the government, unions and employers on welfare state reforms.
A government document presented as a basis for talks on reform was slammed by unions and the hard-left Communist Refoundation party for paying scant attention to employment.

Fazio said that just as "a doctor's sole aim is to make his patient well", the primary concern of those working in the economy "is to make people comfortable and create jobs" and "that politics should create jobs is a principle recognised by all."
